findings.evidence: `nl -ba code/TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Prod.lean` shows lines 136-143 label the theorem as a pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, while line 141 begins `Prod.map ... x = ...`; `rg` confirms Mathlib only has `Diffeomorph.coe_prodCongr` identifying `prodCongr` with `Prod.map` at `mathlib/Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Diffeomorph.lean:549-550`, so this theorem skips the advertised `relativeProdHom` application.
findings.fix: Change the statement to `(relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x = ((p.1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x.1, (p.2 : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) x.2)` or an equivalent coerced subgroup application formula.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is named and documented as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but its left side is only `Prod.map ... x`, so it proves a generic `Prod.map` equation rather than how `(relativeProdHom s t p)` acts.

summary: The relative pointwise API is still mis-formalized: the advertised theorem does not state an application formula for `relativeProdHom`.
